definition: Critical raw materials profile: recycled-content and benchmark requirements for strategic raw materials, in particular permanent magnets, per Regulation (EU) 2024/1252

manifest.issuing_role: manufacturer of the product containing the permanent magnet

legal_basis.citation: 2030 benchmarks for extraction, processing and recycling; recycled-content and digital-product-passport information duties for permanent magnets (Art. 15)

manifest.notes: The recycled-content share is never a copied number: it is computed by the registered aggregation transform over the transformation-event graph (secondary-material inputs divided by total material inputs), under the declared custody model, with published uncertainty and a guard-banded decision rule — a boundary measurement near a quota is a legal-metrology decision (OIML competence), not a rounding accident. Traversal depth 99 with signed roll-up attestations over committed traversal sets keeps deep graphs verifiable without fetching every node.

transforms.method_citation: ISO 59020:2024 (measurement of circularity); mass balance over the recorded genealogy under the declared custody model

transforms.decision_rule: ILAC-G8 guarded acceptance at the quota boundary

triggers.description: product contains a strategic raw material (initial case: NdFeB or SmCo permanent magnets) above the specified thresholds, evaluated at placement
